title: 第3章 仙子沐浴我可是正人君子第4章 师姐你听我解释
lines: “什么情况？这个姑娘深更半夜骑着仙鹤，跑到这里洗澡？”
叶风愣住了，刚要喊出口的声音，也硬生生的堵在了喉咙处。
那双贼眼地滴溜溜的乱转，显然短时间内，他这是不打算开口出声了。
“我叶风可是读春秋的正人君子，是你自已脱的哇……”
叶风在内心中极力否认自已是一个偷窥姑娘沐浴的小色批。
他觉得这应该就是穿越者的福利。
既然是白给的新手福利，不领不就浪费了？
很快，那个白衣姑娘就将自已脱的一件不剩。
在这月色如水的夜晚，这位美丽如仙子一般的姑娘，赤足站在布满大大小小光滑鹅卵石的水潭边。
她的肌肤白皙如玉，细腻柔滑，仿佛经过月光的洗礼，更显晶莹剔透。
她身材很好，尤其是那双腿，修长笔直，令任何男子都会为之疯狂。
她轻轻的迈步，缓缓的踏入潭水中，清澈透明的潭水，立刻泛起淡淡涟漪。
慢慢的，她柔美的身躯便一点点的被潭水覆盖。
乌黑的长发在脑后的水面上，宛如黑墨一般散开。
女子闭上眼睛，享受着这一刻的宁静与舒适，俊美无俦的白皙脸颊上，表情渐渐松弛下来，显得很惬意。
这一幕，让不远处黑暗中的叶风，看的痴了。
只感觉二人之间的距离，似乎在不断的拉近。
他终于看清楚了那个女子的容颜。
那是一张没有任何瑕疵的脸庞，五官精致如画，面庞轮廓清晰，线条柔和，宛如经过精雕细琢的玉石一般。
眼睛很大，很亮，但似乎又带着几分不食人间烟火的清冷。
叶风的脑海中，不禁浮现出了金庸老爷子笔下的小龙女。
仿佛书中人物走到了现实中。
“世间……怎会有如此美丽的女子！”
叶风迷醉其中。
他想成为尹志平那般骑龙战士。
可是，他却没有尹志平的胆量。
胆小怯懦，让他只能远远的看着，不敢靠近……
也不知过了多久，叶风感觉到身后似乎有人对自已的脖子吹气，耳中还听到了呼呼的声音。
他瞬间惊醒，冷汗瞬间出现了在额头。
光顾着看美人出浴了，没有留意到危险的降临。
此刻他明显感觉到身后有野兽……
慢慢的转头……
只见身后不到四米的地方，出现了一头吊睛白额虎。
老虎的体型真大，比地球上的东北虎要大上两三倍！
黑暗中，那双眼睛宛如两颗的蓝色的宝石一般泛着妖异的光芒。
巨虎弓着身体，看过动物世界的都知道，这是对猎物发动攻击前的动作。
叶风暗暗的吞了吞口水。
看着这老虎的体型，看着它那足足快半米长的獠牙，再看看自已这细胳膊细腿，估计三个自已，才能填饱这老虎的肚子。
“镇定！
镇定！”
叶风能清楚的感受到自已浑身的每一个细胞都因为恐惧而颤抖。
距离太近了，只有三四米，老虎一个飞扑，叶风根本无法躲避。
现在叶风只能强行让自已镇定下来。
content_en:
"What's going on? This girl rode a crane and came here to take a bath in the middle of the night?"
Ye Feng was stunned, and the sound he was about to shout was blocked in his throat.
Those evil eyes were darting around, and it was obvious that he had no intention of speaking out in a short period of time.
"I, Ye Feng, am a gentleman who studied in the Spring and Autumn Period. You took off your clothes yourself..."
Ye Feng tried his best to deny in his heart that he was a pervert who peeked at the girl's bath.
He felt that this should be the welfare of time travellers.
Since it’s a free novice benefit, wouldn’t it be wasted if you don’t receive it?
Soon, the girl in white took off every piece of herself.
On this moonlit night, this beautiful fairy-like girl stood barefoot on the edge of a pool covered with large and small smooth pebbles.
Her skin is as white as jade, delicate and smooth, as if it has been baptized by the moonlight, making it even more crystal clear.
She has a great figure, especially her legs, which are long and straight, making any man crazy about her.
She took a gentle step and slowly stepped into the pool. The clear and transparent water immediately showed light ripples.
Slowly, her graceful body was covered bit by bit by the pool water.
The long black hair spreads out like black ink on the water behind her head.
The woman closed her eyes, enjoying the tranquility and comfort of this moment. The expression on her handsome white cheeks gradually relaxed and she looked very comfortable.
This scene made Ye Feng, who was in the darkness not far away, fascinated.
It felt like the distance between the two was getting closer and closer.
He finally saw the woman's face clearly.
It was a face without any flaws, with delicate and picturesque features, clear facial contours, and soft lines, like carefully carved jade.
The eyes are big and bright, but they seem to have a bit of otherworldly coldness.
In Ye Feng's mind, he couldn't help but think of the Little Dragon Girl written by Mr. Jin Yong.
It's as if the characters in the book have come to reality.
"How can there be such a beautiful woman in this world?"
Ye Feng was fascinated by it.
He wants to be a dragon-riding warrior like Yin Zhiping.
However, he did not have Yin Zhiping's courage.
Being timid and cowardly, he could only watch from a distance and did not dare to get close...
I don't know how long it took, but Ye Feng felt as if someone behind him was blowing on his neck, and he heard a whistling sound in his ears.
He woke up instantly, and cold sweat instantly appeared on his forehead.
I just watched the beauty take a bath and didn't notice the danger coming.
At this moment, he clearly felt that there was a beast behind him...
Turn your head slowly...
I saw an eye-catching white-fronted tiger less than four meters behind me.
The tiger is really big, two or three times bigger than the Siberian tiger on earth!
In the darkness, those eyes glowed like two blue gems with a strange light.
The giant tiger arches its body. Anyone who has seen the animal world knows that this is the action before launching an attack on the prey.
Ye Feng swallowed secretly.
Looking at the size of this tiger, looking at its fangs that are almost half a meter long, and looking at my own thin arms and legs, I guess it takes three of me to fill this tiger's belly.
"Calm down!
Calm down! "
Ye Feng could clearly feel that every cell in his body was trembling with fear.
The distance was too close, only three or four meters. The tiger pounced, and Ye Feng could not avoid it at all.
Now Ye Feng could only force himself to calm down.
title_en: Chapter 3 Fairy bathing, I am a gentleman Chapter 4 Senior sister, listen to my explanation
